evidence.observation: Heater H701 temperature climbs steadily 389->396 °C while reboiler T703 stays flat at ~52.8 °C, indicating heat is not transferring to the liquid
Reboiler vessel temperature essentially constant (52.74-52.87) over 20 min — no boil-up
Column section temperatures static ~50.6-51.7 °C, no temperature front developing
Column pressure drop stays slightly negative (~-0.3 mbar), consistent with negligible vapour traffic
Distillate/reflux flows near zero and erratic, with an isolated reflux spike to 1.134

args.missing_evidence: Heater power/setpoint and reboiler level data, plus an independent reboiler temperature check, to distinguish a dry/empty reboiler or failed heat transfer from a T703 thermocouple fault; a composition sample would show whether any separation occurred.
